lines: If you're constantly saving Instagram videos thinking they're gonna be useful, but then never coming back to them, I think I just found your solution.
Follow along for this tutorial, cause I'm gonna take you from unorganized save posts to a full-on travel plan using Muse from Metta.
With Muse, you create your own personal AI agent.
I named mine Champ.
See, the thing is, I just moved to New York and my feed is full of restaurant recs.
But when it's actually time to pick a spot, like I just can't.
So I told Champ, I have all of these NYC restaurant recs in my saved Instagram posts, but I never use them.
Can you look at them and turn them into an interactive map?
All it took was one prompt and my Muse scanned through all of my saves and then got to work.
Look at what it built me.
This is a full interactive map.
It went through and actually found the restaurants the videos were talking about and the interface and ease of use is so beautiful.
It even compiled all the Instagram videos that mention this restaurant.
This is what I think is really cool.
You can use voice mode and say something like, okay, Champ, my girlfriend and I are looking for a chill spot for dinner on Saturday, around $30 a person, preferably near the East Village.
What do you got for me, according to my map?
From your saved map, three East Village spots fit that chill around $30 vibe.
Lil Frankie's on First Avenue is casual with great pizza and open late till four on Saturday.
Since it's Halloween weekend, it'll be lively so earlier might be calmer.
Let's go with Lil Frankie's.
Lil Frankie's is a great pick.
Want me to check anything else about it before Saturday?
Yeah, can you just go ahead and make the reservation?
I'll get your Lil Frankie's reservation for Saturday started.
Going through all those saves myself would have taken me three hours.
Download the Muse app from Meta and try it yourself.

spine.big_idea: Your saved Instagram videos can become a working travel plan if an AI agent does the sorting for you.
spine.before: I save all these videos and never use them
spine.after: My saves could actually turn into a plan I use
spine.viewer: People who save restaurant and travel reels but never revisit them
spine.format: pain callout → promise of tutorial → setup story → one prompt → result demo → voice demo → time saved → download ask
spine.hook_promise: A fix for saved videos you never use again
spine.ask: Download the Muse app and try it, trading on the time saved
why: The hook names a habit the viewer has, so they check themselves
The live voice demo shows the map answering a real dinner question
The three hours number makes the payoff concrete before the ask
